rules.title: Unchecked Reentrancy (Checks-Effects-Interactions Violation)
requiredEvidence: External call (.call, .send, .transfer, or external interface call) before state variable write
Absence of nonReentrant / mutex guard on the function
falsePositiveExclusions: State is updated strictly before external interaction
Function is protected by nonReentrant modifier

rules.title: Missing Access Control on Privileged Function
requiredEvidence: Function transfers native AVAX/ERC20 or mutates critical admin/owner state
Visibility is public or external with no msg.sender / role check
falsePositiveExclusions: Function is protected by onlyOwner, AccessControl, or explicit msg.sender == owner check

rules.title: Authorization via tx.origin
requiredEvidence: Use of tx.origin in require/if authorization check
falsePositiveExclusions: tx.origin == msg.sender used solely as an EOA check (note separately if intentional)

rules.title: Unchecked Low-Level Call Return Value
requiredEvidence: Low-level .call, .delegatecall, or .send without checking the boolean success return value
falsePositiveExclusions: Return boolean is captured and validated with require(success) or custom error revert

rules.title: Arbitrary or Untrusted Delegatecall
requiredEvidence: delegatecall target is user-supplied or mutable storage address without strict allowlist
falsePositiveExclusions: Target is an immutable implementation address in a standard audited proxy

rules.title: Floating Pragma & Outdated Compiler Version
requiredEvidence: pragma solidity uses ^ or >= range instead of a locked version
falsePositiveExclusions: Pragma is locked to a specific version such as pragma solidity 0.8.20;
